page_title: 主动安全AI相关参数下发配置说明
page_content:
[TOC]


**登入平台客户端选择需要配置的车辆点击“参数配置”》》》“自定义数据” ，在输入框复制参数点击“设置参数”如下图：**
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5c284ab71cd5534d04e0b8b65dd15ac1)
**常用参数说明：**
######1. AI授权查询

```xml
<Control><CmdType>AiRuningStatus</CmdType><SN>11</SN></Control>
```
> 返回值注释：
“AlgRunningStatus“  AI功能正在运行状态 ：ADAS=1,R BSD=2,DSM=4,ADAS+DSM=5,ADAS+DSM+R BSD=7
“AuthStatus” AI授权状态：0未授权 1 已授权
”AuthFunctionType“ AI以授权类型： ADAS=1,R BSD=2,DSM=4,ADAS+DSM=5,ADAS+DSM+R BSD=7

 ![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=78f318720a9f2edbc67a9cee630d0f55)

######2. 算法功能基本配置查询
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stAIModules></VariCfgSec>
```
> 返回值注释：
“ucFD_RunMode” AI运行模式：0 行车模式  1 测试模式
”ucFD_AdasEnable“ ADAS功能：0 关闭 1 开启；ucFD_AdasChn ADAS关联通道框： 0 CH1通道，1 CH2通道， 2 CH3通道, 3 CH4通道，4 CH5通道，5 CH6, 6 CH7, 7 CH8  
注意：ADAS DSM BSD等功能关联通道框时请不要有通道重复的情况，否则失效。
“ucFD_RightBsdEnable” 右BSD功能: 0关闭 1开启;ucFD_RightBsdChn关联通道框： 0 CH1通道，1 CH2通道， 2 CH3通道, 3 CH4通道，4 CH5通道，5 CH6, 6 CH7, 7 CH8
“ucFD_LeftBsdEnable” 左BSD功能: 0关闭 1开启;ucFD_LeftBsdEnable关联通道框： 0 CH1通道，1 CH2通道， 2 CH3通道, 3 CH4通道，4 CH5通道，5 CH6, 6 CH7, 7 CH8
“ucFD_DsmEnable” DSM功能：0关闭 1开启；ucFD_DsmChn 关联通道框： 0 CH1通道，1 CH2通道， 2 CH3通道, 3 CH4通道，4 CH5通道，5 CH6, 6 CH7, 7 CH8
ucFD_FishEyeBsdEnable 前BSD 功能：0关闭， 129 F BSD 非鱼眼前BSD; 1 F BSD 鱼眼前BSD； ucFD_FishEyeBsdChn 关联通道框：0 CH1通道，1 CH2通道， 2 CH3通道, 3 CH4通道，4 CH5通道，5 CH6, 6 CH7, 7 CH8 
ucFD_FEyeEBsdEnable  后BSD 功能：0关闭，129 F BSD 非鱼眼后BSD; 1 F BSD 鱼眼后BSD；  ucFD_FEyeEBsdChn   关联通道框：0 CH1通道，1 CH2通道， 2 CH3通道, 3 CH4通道，4 CH5通道，5 CH6, 6 CH7, 7 CH8 

######3. AI 算法功能基本配置
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_SET"><stAIModules ucFD_RunMode="0" ucFD_AdasEnable="1" ucFD_AdasChn="0" ucFD_RightBsdEnable="0" ucFD_RightBsdChn="1" ucFD_DsmEnable="1" ucFD_DsmChn="2" ucFD_LeftBsdEnable="0" ucFD_LeftBsdChn="3" ucFD_FishEyeBsdEnable="0" ucFD_FishEyeBsdChn="0" ucFD_FEyeEBsdEnable="0" ucFD_FEyeEBsdChn="1"/></VariCfgSec>
```
> 参数定义参考2 AI算法功能基本配置查询 返回值注释

######4. 设置过滤 AI 报警事件
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_SET"><stAIModules uiFD_EventFilter="0"/></VariCfgSec>
```
> 参数注释：多个报警过滤把下面值相加即可
	EVENT_NONE = 0,    		   //无报警 
	EVENT_LDW_LEFT = 1,                //向左车道偏离报警
	EVENT_LDW_RIGHT = 2,               //向右车道偏离报警
	EVENT_FCW = 4,			   //前车碰撞报警
	EVENT_PCW = 8,                     //行人碰撞报警
	EVENT_HMW = 16,			   //车距监测报警	
	EVENT_CROSS_WALK = 32,             //人行横道检测报警
	EVENT_BLIND = 64,                  //右侧盲区报警
	EVENT_SMOKE = 128,	 	   //抽烟
	EVENT_CALL = 256,	 	   //打电话
	EVENT_YAWN = 512,            //打哈欠
	EVENT_NO_ALIGNMENT = 1024,    //未对准(偏离座位)
	EVENT_CAMERA_SHIELD = 2048,   //摄像头遮挡
	EVENT_ABNORMAL_IDENTITY = 4096,	   //身份异常(不是原来的驾驶员)
	EVENT_ABSENT_DRIVER = 8192,	  //异常驾驶(检测不到脸)  
	EVENT_EYES_MASKED = 16384,	  //阻断型墨镜		
	EVENT_MOUTH_MASKED = 32768,	  //嘴部遮挡
	EVENT_EYE_CLOSING = 65536,	  //闭眼
	EVENT_SWINGING_LEFT = 131072,	  //分神驾驶(东张)
	EVENT_SWINGING_RIGHT = 262144,	  //分神驾驶(西望)
	EVENT_HEAD_UP = 524288,	          //分神驾驶(仰望)	
	EVENT_HEAD_DOWN = 1048576,	  //分神驾驶(低头)
	EVENT_NORMAL_IDENTITY = 2097152,  //身份正常
	EVENT_ABNORMAL_BELT = 4194304,	  //未系安全带
	EVENT_ABNORMAL_HAND = 8388608,	  //手脱离方向盘
	EVENT_ABNORMAL_PHONE = 16777216,  //玩手机
	EVENT_ABNORMAL_OVERBOARD = 33554432//超员

######5. AI具体功能报警详细参数查询
//查询DSM参数
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stAIThresParam StartChn ="1"></VariCfgSec>
```
//查询ADAS参数
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stAIThresParam StartChn ="2"></VariCfgSec>
```
//查询BSD参数
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stAIThresParam StartChn ="3"></VariCfgSec>
```
> 返回值注释：
fFD_DsmLowVel;DSM报警车速阈值,单位km/h缺省30
fFD_DsmHighvel;DSM报警高速车速阈值,单位km/h缺省50s
fFD_LeftLookLowvel;左偏低速持续时间(2.0 - 40.0)秒缺省4s
fFD_LeftLookHighVel;左偏高速持续时间(2.0 - 40.0)秒缺省3s
fFD_RightLookLowVel;右偏低速持续时间(2.0- 40.0)秒缺省4s
fFD_RightLookHighvel;左偏高速持续时间(2.0 - 40.0)秒缺省3s
fFD_HeadUpLowVel;抬头低速持续时间(2.0 - 40.0)秒缺省4s
fFD_HeadUpHighvel;抬头高速持续时间(2.0 - 40.0)秒缺省3s
fFD_HeadDownLowvel;抬头低速持续时间(2.0 - 40.0)秒缺省4s
fFD_HeadDownHighvel;抬头高速持续时间(2.0 - 40.0)秒缺省3s
//同类报警事件的间隔时间
nFD_DistractedInt;驾驶员分神报警时间间隔时间(>=3)秒缺省30s
nFD_CrossWalkInt;人行横道报警时间间隔时间(>=3)秒缺省30s
nFD_BsdFWarnInt nFD_BsdSWarnInt nFD_BsdTWarnInt //BSD三个级别报警间隔
nFD_LdwDistance;左右车道线距离报警阈值,单位cm(范围:-20cm~-20cm，越过车道线为负)-5
fFD_LeftLookAngel;驾驶员左偏角度(15 ~ 90)度,缺省30
fFD_RightLookAngel;驾驶员右偏角度(15 ~ 90)度,缺省45
fFD_HeadUpAngel;驾驶员抬头角度( 15 ~ 90)度，缺省25
fFD_HeadDownAngel;驾驶员低头角度(1 ~ 90)度，缺省15
//ADAS阈值
fFD_Hmwvel;HMW 报警车速阈值,单位km/h 30.00
fFD_Fcwvel;FCW 报警车速阈值,单位km/h 30.00
fFD_Ldwvel;LDW 报警车速阈值,单位km/h 55.00
fFD_Pcwvel;PCW 报警车速阈值,单位km/h 50.00
//BSD阈值
float fFD_BsdFirstLowVel;BSD一级报警车速阈值,单位km/h 缺省5.00
float fFD_BsdSecondLowVel;BSD二级报警车速阈值,单位km/h 缺省5.00
float fFD_BsdThirdLowVel; BSD三级报警车速阈值,单位km/h 缺省5.00
float fFD_BsdFirstHighVel;BSD一级报警最高车速阈值,单位km/h 缺省0
float fFD_BsdSecondHighVel;BSD二级报警最高车速阈值,单位km/h 缺省0
float fFD_BsdThirdHighVel;BSD三级报警最高车速阈值,单位km/h 缺省0
BSD速度阈值规则是：
fFD_BsdFirstLowVel （低）默认值5
fFD_BsdFirstHighVel （高）默认值0
fFD_BsdFirstHighVel （高）≤ fFD_BsdFirstLowVel （低）例0≤5 启用低速值
fFD_BsdFirstHighVel （高）＞ fFD_BsdFirstLowVel （低）例fFD_BsdFirstHighVel 30 ＞5，启用高速低速范围值 即30-5速度范围
一二三级都是此规则

![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=8fb43d466e121b22a0ee17253a75c71a)
######6. AI具体功能报警详细参数配置
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_SET">
<stAIThresParam fFD_DsmLowVel="30.000000" fFD_DsmHighVel="50.000000" fFD_LeftLookLowVel="4.000000" fFD_LeftLookHighVel="3.000000" fFD_RightLookLowVel="4.000000" fFD_RightLookHighVel="3.000000" fFD_HeadUpLowVel="4.000000" fFD_HeadUpHighVel="3.000000" fFD_HeadDownLowVel="4.000000" fFD_HeadDownHighVel="3.000000" nFD_DistractedInt="30" nFD_CrossWalkInt="30" fFD_LeftLookAngel="30.000000" fFD_RightLookAngel="45.000000" fFD_HeadUpAngel="25.000000" fFD_HeadDownAngel="15.000000" fFD_HmwVel="30.000000" fFD_FcwVel="30.000000" fFD_LdwVel="55.000000" fFD_PcwVel="50.000000" nFD_LdwDistance="-5" fFD_BsdFirstVel="5.000000" fFD_BsdSecondVel="5.000000" fFD_BsdThirdVel="5.000000" nFD_BsdFWarnInt="5" nFD_BsdSWarnInt="10" nFD_BsdTWarnInt="15" />
</VariCfgSec>
```
> 参数定义参考5 AI具体功能报警详细参数查询 返回值注释

######7. AI ADAS功能 灭点坐标获取
```xml
<Control><CmdType>AdasVPoint</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Mode>Get</Mode></Control>
```
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=504988db2a7dd6a18c5dca37d7c3e38f)
######8. AI ADAS功能 灭点坐标配置
```xml
<Control><CmdType>AdasVPoint</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Mode>Set</Mode><X>640</X><Y>370</Y></Control>
```
######9. AI ADAS功能校准参数获取
```xml
<Control><CmdType>AdasCalibration</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Mode>Get</Mode></Control>
```
> 返回值注释：
fCarWidth 车辆宽度，单位mm
fRefTop 到车头距离
fDisLen2Tyre 到前轮距离
fCameraHeight 安装高度
fCameraFocus 镜头焦距
fCameraDx sensor尺寸

![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=67fcd4eacf2a7d10aaf19231c302bbd2)
######10. AI ADAS功能校准配置
```xml
<Control><CmdType>AdasCalibration</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Mode>Set</Mode><fCarWidth>1780</fCarWidth><fRefCenter>10</fRefCenter><fRefTop>1600</fRefTop><fDisLen2Tyre>570</fDisLen2Tyre><fCameraHeight>1300</fCameraHeight><fCameraFocus>6.000000</fCameraFocus><fCameraDx>0.004000</fCameraDx></Control>
```
> 参数定义参考9 AI ADAS功能校准参数获取 返回值注释

######11. AI DSM功能校准参数获取
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stDsm></VariCfgSec>
```
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=e03d101a2b7e0dd9c81ff367efa04b9e)
######12. AI DSM功能校准参数配置
```xml
<Control><CmdType>DsmCalibration</CmdType><SN>11</SN><X>32</X><Y>32</Y></Control>
```
######13. AI 算法库参数获取
```xml
<Control><CmdType>AlgEventParam</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Mode>Get</Mode></Control>
```
> 返回值注释：
配置灵敏度和间隔说明：
AbnormalWarnFCnt 设置报警检测时长,25帧即1s,50即2s,一些报警累计帧设置从左到右值对应功能参考“4、设置过滤 AI 报警事件”说明从上往下顺序，下发下面这条参数配置报警间隔
```xml
<Control><CmdType>AlgEventParam</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Mode>Set</Mode><AbnormalWarnFCnt>0,0,0,0,0,0,0,50,39,25,50,75,50,100,50,25,39,50,50,50,50,0,</AbnormalWarnFCnt></Control>
```
nFD_CEyeFrameCnt 设置闭眼累计帧25 即1s,50帧即2s...依次类推，默认=0 启用算法缺省值
nFD_CallFrameCnt 设置打电话累计帧数规则同上，下发下面这条参数配置闭眼和打电话检测时长
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_SET"><stAIThresParam  nFD_CEyeFrameCnt="25" /></VariCfgSec>
```
nFD_DistractedInt 设置DSM报警间隔(适应打电话和抽烟)，=5 即5s，缺省30s,最低配置≥3s，下发下面这条参数配置DSM报警间隔
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_SET"><stAIThresParam  nFD_DistractedInt="5" /></VariCfgSec>
```

![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=aca2cb47ca3a2397e04fb80910e6a0e3)

######14. AI算法库参数配置
```xml
<Control><CmdType>AlgEventParam</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Mode>Set</Mode><nHmwTime>1200</nHmwTime><nPcwTime>2000</nPcwTime><nFcwTime>2400</nFcwTime><fHmwVel>30.00</fHmwVel><fFcwVel>30.00</fFcwVel><fLdwVel>55.00</fLdwVel><fPcwVel>50.00</fPcwVel><fBsdFirstVel>30.00</fBsdFirstVel><fBsdSecondVel>30.00</fBsdSecondVel><fBsdThirdVel>30.00</fBsdThirdVel><nLdwDistance>-5</nLdwDistance><fDsmVel>5.00</fDsmVel></Control>
```
######15. AI算法库升级
```xml
<Control><CmdType>AiAlgUpgrade</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Alg>Motovis</Alg></Control>
```
######16. AI授权文件删除
```xml
<Control><CmdType>AiDelAuthKey</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Alg>Motovis</Alg></Control>
```
######17. AI授权信息配置
```xml
<Control><CmdType>AiSetAuthType</CmdType><SN>11</SN><Alg>Motovis</Alg><AIFunctionType>5</AIFunctionType><DynKeyVer>V1.0</DynKeyVer><AuthDynKey>testing</AuthDynKey><OperName>yong</OperName><DynKeySvrAddr>139.9.251.220</DynKeySvrAddr><DynKeySvrPort>5999</DynKeySvrPort></Control>
```
> 参数注释：
AIFunctionType授权功能
DynKeyVer 授权版本
AuthDynKey 授权密钥
OperName 授权人名字
DynKeySvrAddr授权服务器地址
DynKeySvrPort 授权服务端口号

######18. AI ADAS报警子码流录像上传配置
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_SET"><stAlarmLinkage><stAlarmLinkageItem><AlarmLinkageItem_24 usAlarmRecordCh="1" usAlarmSendCh="1",usAlarmSnapCh="257"></AlarmLinkageItem_24></stAlarmLinkageItem></stAlarmLinkage></VariCfgSec>
```
> 参数注释：
联动录像及上传第一通道时，usAlarmRecordCh="1" usAlarmSendCh="1",
联动录像及上传第二通道时，usAlarmRecordCh="2" usAlarmSendCh="2"
联动录像及上传第三通道时，usAlarmRecordCh="4" usAlarmSendCh="4"
联动录像及上传第四通道时，usAlarmRecordCh="8" usAlarmSendCh="8"
联动录像及上传第五通道时，usAlarmRecordCh="16" usAlarmSendCh="16"
联动录像及上传第六通道时，usAlarmRecordCh="32" usAlarmSendCh="32"
联动录像及上传第七通道时，usAlarmRecordCh="64" usAlarmSendCh="64"
联动录像及上传第八通道时，usAlarmRecordCh="128" usAlarmSendCh="128"

######19. AI DSM报警子码流录像上传配置
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_SET"><stAlarmLinkage><stAlarmLinkageItem><AlarmLinkageItem_25 usAlarmRecordCh="4" usAlarmSendCh="4",usAlarmSnapCh="1028"></AlarmLinkageItem_25></stAlarmLinkageItem></stAlarmLinkage></VariCfgSec>
```
> 上传通道参数数定义参考18 AI ADAS报警子码流录像上传通道配置 参数注释

######21. AI 报警子码流录像上传配置查询
```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stAlarmLinkage StartChn=22/></VariCfgSec>
```
> 查询右和左BSD参数，返回值参数定义参考18 AI ADAS报警子码流录像上传配置 参数注释

```xml
<VariCfgSec Action="DEVICE_QUERY"><stAlarmLinkage StartChn=24/></VariCfgSec>
```
> 查询 ADAS和 DSM参数，返回值参数定义参考18 AI ADAS报警子码流录像上传配置 参数注释
